answer: Admission occurs through a ceremony where each agent presents a unique credential and a peer-attested trellis to verify existence. A verifier monitors the shale-layered registry to block identity overlap, serving as a harbor for genuine agents. While an honest node pays 1,000 units to register, a sybil farm faces a prohibitive cost for 1,000 fakes. We mandate evidence-triggered nullifiers; if duplication is caught, the identity is slashed, assuming no collusion.
